impact.text: Lingering `investmentShareToken` allowance on previous vault even after vault update

precondition_sources.text: investmentShareToken has been configured for the ShareTokenUpgradeable contract.
A vaultAddress has been registered via registerVault(), during which _configureVaultInvestmentSettings() set a max allowance for investmentShareToken to that vaultAddress.

intent_sources.text: When a vault is unregistered, the investmentShareToken allowance previously granted to that vault must be revoked so no approval remains to the old vault.
